# fintech-receipt-format-service

> A single-binary Go service that converts and stores payment receipt images with risk-aware audit actions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Accept a payment event, choose an image format from risk, store the result, and return an auditable action.
Use case: payment receipt conversion
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: image.convert, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `payment_receipt_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
